attributes.title: browse_existing_tags
attributes.description: Read-only browse of one folder level of the Ignition tag tree. Lists each child's name, full path, whether it has children, and its tag/data type. Use it only to check naming conventions and to find UDT definitions worth reusing instead of duplicating -- it never modifies anything, and finding something here does not make it writable. Always browse '[default]Exchange/Tag Import Agent' before finalizing a proposal, to check for collisions. Browse '[default]_types_/Exchange/Tag Import Agent' to see UDT definitions that already exist.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Folder path to browse, e.g. '[default]Exchange/Tag Import Agent' or '[default]_types_/Exchange/Tag Import Agent'. A path with no [provider] prefix is assumed to be [default]. Omit to browse the [default] provider root.
